evidence: Risk item 3 (contracts others consume): engine/review/app/launch.go:81-89 re-asks only when reAsk accepts the first error and returns the second Record result unchanged; engine/cmd/review.go:607-610 still maps *ReplyRefusedError to exit 2, and a reviewer error on the second run is returned as is (exit 1, nothing stored), so the exit-code contract is unchanged.

engine/review/app/launch.go:72-76 and 82: with WithFrozenContext, `brief` is reassigned to brief+frozen context before the first Review, so the re-ask carries it; the added size is checked against review.MaxReplyBytes at launch.go:109.

engine/review/app/service.go:152-170: Record refuses before EncodeResult or any store write, so a refused first reply leaves no stored file, counter or number before the re-ask (test asserts store.created()==1 on success, 0 on second refusal).

Data/security: engine/review/codexexec/codexexec.go:77-103 creates a fresh MkdirTemp scratch and last-message file per Review call, so the second run cannot read a stale reply from the first; engine/review/claudeprint/claudeprint.go:77-98 starts a new tool-free claude --print with --no-session-persistence; both keep the same read-only sandbox and worktree.

app.go:254-264: ReplyRefusedError unwraps to the named reviewresult error; shapeRefusals excludes ErrCandidateMismatch and review.ErrReplyTooLarge, so binding, inspection and size refusals still return at once (TestLaunchDoesNotAskAgainWhenTheReplyIsRefusedForItsBinding).
Concurrency/delivery: no shared state between the two runs; no caller-side timeout around `review launch` found, so a worst case of two 30-minute runs per launch has no impact outside the process.
Tests: launch_test.go covers re-ask then record, second refusal returned, no re-ask on binding refusal, no re-ask over the size bound; none were run (reviewer is read-only).
